messages:
Maria K.: quick lunchtime poll — who wants to do a short hill-rep sprint session at Park North steps vs a mellow yoga flow on the lawn? reply with 🏃 or 🧘
Jon P.: 🏃 if it's dry. new trail shoes ready.
Alex T.: 🧘 I could do yoga, will bring a mat.
Sam: could we split — 20m hill sprints + 10m stretch?
Maria K.: good thought. let's poll properly. @FitBot create poll: Hill Reps (🏃) / Yoga Flow (🧘)
FitBot: Poll created: Hill Reps — vote :one: ; Yoga Flow — vote :two:. Poll ends in 45 minutes.
Jen L.: :two: today I'm feeling sore — gentle please.
Jon P.: :one: also FYI the north route has a muddy patch by the creek, take the high line.
Maria K.: noted. meet by north entrance at 12:05?
Alex T.: works for me. can someone bring an extra mat if Jen wants to sit?
Sam: I can bring a mat and a small first-aid kit.
Jon P.: bringing a couple of cliff bars too.
Maria K.: rain plan: light drizzle -> covered shelter by the playground; heavy rain -> reschedule to Thu. sound ok?
Jen L.: perfect.
Sam: any pace targets for hill reps?
Jon P.: 6 rounds: sprint up, walk down, 60–90s rest. adjust as needed.
Alex T.: I'll lead the cooldown yoga sequence after if people want to stay.
FitBot: Poll closed: Hill Reps 3 votes, Yoga Flow 2 votes.
Maria K.: hill reps win. see you all at 12:05 north entrance. bring water, shoes you don't mind dirtying, and a good attitude. :smile:
thread_text_summary: Short Slack thread organizing a lunchtime hill-rep sprint vs yoga poll; logistics (meeting spot, rain plan), quick votes, and snack/mat offers.
